configuration: Generic early-war Type VIIC, 1941, informed by U-570; surfaced gameplay preset
acquisition: U-boat Archive HTTPS certificate hostname validation failed with system curl; public reference-only files retrieved with a host-scoped curl -k fallback. Web tool independently exposed matching report contents. No game model files were used.

sources.title: ONI report on U-570, inspected September 23–26, 1941
supports: Four bow tubes and one stern tube, 14 torpedoes in the surveyed load
Diesels, electric motors, saddle tanks, deck fittings and compartment order
8.8 cm deck gun and 20 mm platform weapon
Approximately 8 kn maximum submerged speed in the captured-boat survey; the 7.6 kn nominal game setting is not a reproduction of this trial
sources.limits: Survey dimensions and load are not a complete build specification; not every feature was directly measured.

sources.title: General arrangement enclosure A to the ONI report

sources.limits: Used to guide independent station and fitting estimates; no calibrated tracing or station survey claimed.

sources.title: Photographs accompanying the U-570 survey
